chapter_note: Core teaching dominates the middle and end with a cosmological definition of Love (as the Father of Greatness) and Hate (as the first Death/Darkness-principle) operating in the time of mixture. The chapter opens with a standard dialogue/frame question. A major later graft applies the definition of love to the holy church and the apostle and then anchors it with an explicit written Gospel saying (NT overlay).

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue frame (“Once again he speaks to his disciples: What is…”) with lacunae; functions as the compiler’s container rather than impersonal cosmological exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Love is the Father of Greatness, who dwells in his glorious land. The entirety of the divine has been revealed [there]in! These two are a single living body, the Father and his love; because he has given himself for every thing, as he exists in his aeons. Indeed, due to this, they called the Father, the Lord of the totality, 'love'. For he gave the victory to his aeons and his limbs.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal cosmological-identificatory teaching: Love is defined as a hypostatized cosmic/divine reality (Father of Greatness) within the aeonic system, without institutional application or citation.

Editorial application of the concept to the holy church and the apostle (cosmos→institution), culminating in an explicit ‘it is written’ Gospel quotation (entry via NT), marking this whole paragraph as later Christian overlay despite some cosmic terms (e.g., Mind).

paragraphs.core_text: Hate is the first death that welled up. It revealed the land of darkness. This one called 'hate', because it has ruined all its perdition's offspring; it sinned even against a power foreign to it, and ruined it. Due to this they shall call it 'hated'; for it has caused destruction, both wounding in flesh, and what is not its own.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the dialogue/frame attribution and question: “Once again he speaks: What, conversely, is hate?” (a compiler-style Q&A seam introducing the teaching).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core substance is a systematic cosmogonic definition of Hate as an originating Death/Darkness-principle acting within the cosmic drama; the only late element is the hagiographic/compilational speech-introduction formula.

paragraphs.core_text: Today again it causes wounding and destruction in all flesh. It kills them all with diverse deaths; these that are displayed today in every thing, in every type. Even the Cross of Light, the living soul, likewise too it ruins and kills them; as it did at the start. Indeed, due to this have they called it 'hated', this one from the hated; the envy from the envy; the devil from the devil; the bad that came about from the bad.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the same cosmological agency-description (Hate harming flesh and the Cross of Light/Living Soul) without pivoting to church discipline or exhortation. The repeated ‘today’ could reflect a mixture-era horizon, but it remains internal to the Light–Darkness system rather than pointing to contemporary institutions.
